label: Peplink MAX Transit Duo (multi-LTE)
description: Transportation router with two LTE modems: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the MAX Transit datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **1 / 0 (GE)**, LAN port **1 / 2 (GE)**, **Router Throughput 400 Mbps**, Wi-Fi AP Yes, PoE Input No. The slash means the single WAN port can be reconfigured as a second LAN port. Two modems share a 400 Mbps router ceiling, so bonding two carriers cannot deliver their sum.
